outcome: Urogenital Distress Inventory Short Form (UDI-6) score
Incontinence Impact Questionnaire Short Form (IIQ-7) score
cohort: 866 women delivering newborns at a tertiary hospital
finding: Persistent SUI was more prevalent in the vaginal delivery group than the Cesarean group, and both SUI during pregnancy and after childbirth negatively impacted the quality of life in women undergoing vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Persistent SUI was more prevalent in the vaginal delivery group than the Cesarean group.
